name: Lanterne ancienne
descriptionEn: Old enough to be considered an antique, yet functional enough to light your way forward. Use to acquire an antique lantern.

sources.textEn: Expedition Antiquarian - North Horn - 40 Arcane Amulets

name: Mitrailleuse rotative d'Avalanche
descriptionEn: A sleek, rapid-fire weapon, modeled after the one wielded by a fearless hero of legend. Use to acquire an Avalanche Gatling gun.

name: Pelle
descriptionEn: A sturdy wooden shovel designed for the stylish adventurer seeking to dig themself out of a fashion crisis. Use to unlock a shovel.

name: Sac à dos Señor Loutre
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Sac à dos Señor Loutre”.
descriptionEn: Handcrafted for aspiring globe-trotters. Use to acquire a Senor Otter pack.

name: Ombrelle corvosienne
descriptionEn: Made of ornate cloth woven as elegantly as any well-told tale. Use to unlock a Corvosi parasol.

sources.text: Contes du Camelot - Donjon à embranchements

name: Ombrelle spriggan
descriptionEn: Protect yourself from the elements in mischievously fuzzy style. Use to acquire a spriggan parasol.

sources.text: Concours d'art et de vidéo du Fan Festival 2026

name: Ombrelle pixie bleue
descriptionEn: Protects the bearer from rain and sun, but not from pixie mischief. Use to acquire a blue pixie parasol.

sources.textEn: Pilgrim's Traverse - Sack of First Light

name: Ombrelle pixie
descriptionEn: Protects the bearer from rain and sun, but not from pixie mischief. Use to acquire a pixie parasol.

sources.text: Sanctuaire des pèlerins - Trésor insoupçonné de grade I et III

name: Ombrelle Mizutsune Felyne
descriptionEn: An extravagant parasol fashioned after a creature of another world. Use to acquire a Mizutsune parasol.

name: Torche
descriptionEn: Ideal for adventurers who like their light sources accompanied by the scent of burning pine sap. Use to acquire a torch.

name: Ombrelle à dentelles blanche
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Ombrelle à dentelles blanche”.
descriptionEn: Because there is no such thing as “too many frills” on a fashion accessory─or so the enigmatic crafter of this parasol believed when they lovingly stitched it together. Use to acquire a white embroidered parasol.

sources.textEn: Expedition Antiquarian - South Horn - 30 Chunks of Sanguinite

sources.text: L'île de Lunule méridionale - Coffre des lapins du bonheur/Pots persistants

name: Ombrelle à dentelles noire
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Ombrelle à dentelles noire”.
descriptionEn: Crafted with the finest lace gil can buy, this ornate parasol was designed for those fashionable frill-seekers who wish to accessorize in more subdued shades. Use to acquire a black embroidered parasol.

sources.textEn: Expedition Antiquarian - South Horn - 30 Chunks of Sanguinite

sources.text: L'île de Lunule méridionale - Coffre des lapins du bonheur/Pots persistants

name: Ombrelle loporrite
descriptionEn: No matter your distance from the sun, this parasol will protect your skin and nurture your dreams. Use to acquire a Loparasol.

sources.text: Roue de la fortune cosmique - Sinus Ardorum

name: Paraplœuf
descriptionEn: Finished in a striking yellow and golden trim, this accessory provides eggceptional protection against all but the worst of downpours. Use to unlock an Archon egg parasol.

name: Sac de voyage pelupelu
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Sac de voyage pelupelu”.
descriptionEn: A rustic receptacle for all your Pelupossessions. Use to unlock a Pelupack.

sources.text: Pavli - Embarcadère de Poga (Kozama'uka) - 10 pluplumes pelupelu (Rang 6)

name: Ombrelle mandragore
descriptionEn: Whether you want to blend in amongst potentially sentient seedkin, or simply keep your head dry, this parasol quite literally has you covered. Use to unlock a mandragora parasol.

name: Ombrelle à rubans
descriptionEn: Embellished with an array of red ribbons, this understated parasol is perfect for adding a splash of elegance to a rainy day ensemble. Use to unlock a ribboned parasol.

name: Ombrelle bombo
descriptionEn: A dazzling paper parasol bedecked with bombs of all sizes. Whether or not it is bomb-*proof*, however, is a different story. Use to unlock a bomb parasol.

name: Ombrelle à néons
descriptionEn: Crafted with highly reflective and luminescent materials, this parasol is a bright ray of synthetic sunshine in inclement weather. Use to unlock a neon parasol.

name: Sac d'explorateur
descriptionEn: Research has proven that wearing a knapsack or similar greatly reduces the likelihood of being pestered with questions about how you can carry so many items. Use to acquire a knapsack.

name: Parapluie feuille
descriptionEn: This is a crafted *imitation* of plant life, not simply errant vegetation cleverly pruned for capitalistic purposes. Honest. Use to acquire a giant leaf parasol.

name: Ailes de Statice
descriptionEn: For those who have indulged their mischievous side and now long for something *stronger*. Use to acquire a pair of Statice's wings.

sources.text: Trisassant - Vieille Sharlayan - 3 reliques de l'île d'Aloalo

name: Ombrelle carotte
descriptionEn: Nine out of ten Loporrits agree─this parasol is without flaw. The tenth could not be reached for comment due to a carrot-induced stomachache. Use to acquire a colorful carrotsol.

name: Parapluie Tsukumogami
descriptionEn: Designed in the likeness of a Far Eastern umbrella spirit, this parasol is certain to attract quizzical eyes (and slobbery tongues). Use to unlock a tsukumogami parasol.

sources.text: Le mont Rokkon - Donjon à embranchements

name: Parapluie Bernartisan
descriptionEn: A handy accessory to have when you need a large visual reminder that there is work to be done and schedules to keep. Use to acquire a tactful taskmaster umbrella.

name: Système de protection anti-gouttes
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Système de protection anti-gouttes”.
descriptionEn: This advanced piece of technology was painstakingly designed to protect its bearer from descending moisture─no matter the cost. Use to acquire a raindrop defense system.

sources.text: Eurêka Orthos - Trésor étrange de grade I

name: Parapluie Chamoiselle
descriptionEn: Thankfully, this parasol is not nearly as indolent as its eponymous mammet, and will be sure to keep you dry during island squalls without a word of complaint. Use to acquire a felicitous furball umbrella.

name: Ombrelle pampa
descriptionEn: Equipped with this accessory, none shall prevent you twirling to your heart's delight─or else. Use to acquire a sabotender parasol.

sources.text: Les canalisations sildiennes - Donjon à embranchements

name: Ailes de Pixie bleues
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Ailes de Pixie bleues”.
descriptionEn: Indulge your mischievous side once more, this time in a charming shade of aquamarine. Use to acquire a pair of bluepowder pixie wings.

name: Ombrelle à fleurs bleues
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Ombrelle à fleurs bleues”.
descriptionEn: A white umbrella printed with a charming pattern of blue flowers, moogles, chocobos, and more. Use to unlock a blue blossom parasol.

sources.text: Subaquatic Voyages - Sirensong Sea (F/I/N), The Lilac Sea (B), South Indigo Deep (B)
sources.textEn: Subaquatic Voyages - Sirensong Sea (F/I/N), The Lilac Sea (B), South Indigo Deep (B)

name: Ombrelle à collerette blanche
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Ombrelle à collerette blanche”.
descriptionEn: A frill-rimmed umbrella perfect for any weather except rain. Use to unlock a white lace parasol.

name: Ailes d'archange
descriptionEn: For those who go gaga for gold. Use to acquire a pair of archangel wings.

name: Ailes de Pixie
descriptionEn: Perfect for those who like to indulge their mischievous side. Use to acquire a pair of pixie wings.

sources.text: Vieille carte en peau de kumbhira/d'ophiotauros

name: Ailes de Diabolos
descriptionEn: Highly recommended for those who feel an affinity with voidsent. Use to acquire a pair of Diabolos wings.

sources.text: J'lakshai (Vieille Sharlayan) / Wilmetta (Radz-at-Han) - 800 insignes de Chasse
sources.textEn: J'lakshai (Old Sharlayan) / Wilmetta (Radz-at-Han) - 800 Sacks Of Nuts

name: Ailes d'ange déchu
descriptionEn: The perfect solution for anyone seeking a pair of edgier angel wings. Use to acquire a pair of fallen angel wings.

sources.text: Edelina - Mor Dhona - 500 bons de livraison de gemmes bicolores
sources.textEn: Edelina - Mor Dhona - 500 Bicolor Gemstone Vouchers

name: Parapluie Dalamud
descriptionEn: This elegant parasol features an image of a flaming moon, which seems strangely familiar... Use to acquire a red moon parasol.

name: Parapluie Serpent marin de Ronka ?
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Parapluie Serpent marin de Ronka ?”.
descriptionEn: So lifelike that it appears about to let forth a mighty “scree!” at any moment. Use to acquire a great paraserpent.

name: Ombrelle gros minou
descriptionEn: A charming parasol that's perfect for lounging about in the sun after filling your belly to bursting. Use to acquire a fat cat parasol.

name: Ombrelle bleue à pois
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Ombrelle bleue à pois”.
descriptionEn: Should the weather prove so inclement, the skies so heavy with rain, that one is forced to rely upon a parasol, can it truly be called pleasant? (Yes. Just look at the name.) Use to acquire a pleasant dot parasol.

name: Ombrelle vert d'eau à pois
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Ombrelle vert d'eau à pois”.
descriptionEn: It could be argued that any parasol could be made to appear pastoral if set against a suitably bucolic background. Use to acquire a pastoral dot parasol.

sources.textEn: Bronze Ancient Record - Oizys or Auxesia

name: Ombrelle rose à pois
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Ombrelle rose à pois”.
descriptionEn: Whether or not this parasol could be considered prim rather depends on the person holding it at the time. Use to acquire a prim dot parasol.

sources.textEn: Pixie Hoarder - Lydha Lran (Il Mheg) - 100,000 Gil

name: Ombrelle du Gold Saucer
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Ombrelle du Gold Saucer”.
descriptionEn: Nothing exudes an air of both wealth and whimsy as perfectly as a parasol decorated with stars and sabotenders, or so its creators convinced themselves when conjuring up this madcap design. Use to acquire a gold parasaucer.

name: Ailes angéliques
descriptionEn: Perhaps a little *too* realistic. It would be wise to look out for a newly wingless angel seeking revenge. Use to acquire a pair of angel wings.

name: Ombrelle à carreaux noire
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Ombrelle à carreaux noire”.
descriptionEn: Were one to describe this parasol's pattern as “black-and-white check” then perhaps it might conjure images of chessboards and the like. Even so, it could be argued that this design is far classier. Use to acquire a classy checkered parasol.

sources.text: Coffre verrouillé du Front sud de Bozja

name: Ombrelle à carreaux rouge
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Ombrelle à carreaux rouge”.
descriptionEn: There is something about a white background covered in many, many straight red lines that creates a cheerful atmosphere, though scholars have yet to determine exactly why. Use to acquire a cheerful checkered parasol.

name: Ombrelle à carreaux bleue
description: Permet d'obtenir l'action “Ombrelle à carreaux bleue”.
descriptionEn: Creates not only a small, portable circle of shade, but exudes a calming influence. Somehow. Use to acquire a calming checkered parasol.

sources.textEn: Bronze Ancient Record - Oizys or Auxesia

name: Parapluie doré laqué
descriptionEn: Unfortunately not covered in gold leaf, but fool's gold leaf, which is considerably cheaper on account of its rather silly name. Use to acquire a gold paper parasol.

name: Parapluie mauve laqué
descriptionEn: Named for its color, not because the paper is made from the wood of a plum tree. Use to acquire a plum paper parasol.

sources.text: Subaquatic Voyages - Sea of Jade (F/P), Sirensong Sea (F), South Indigo Deep (G)
sources.textEn: Subaquatic Voyages - Sea of Jade (F/P), Sirensong Sea (F), South Indigo Deep (G)

name: Parapluie pourpre laqué
descriptionEn: Though one might assume that paper is less than ideal for protecting oneself from the rain, this parasol has been treated with waterproof oil. The makers cannot, however, be held responsible for any puddles stepped in. Use to acquire a vermilion paper parasol.

name: Ombrelle d'azur
descriptionEn: The perfect accessory to protect you from the summer sun, spring showers, and birds seeking to relieve themselves. Use to acquire a sky blue parasol.

name: Ombrelle
descriptionEn: The perfect accessory to protect you from the summer sun, spring showers, and birds seeking to relieve themselves. Use to acquire a parasol.
